title: CRYPTONEWS:Bitcoin at $91,000, Zcash ETF, Avalanche and European trading system
description:
Episode summary

Grayscale filed to convert its Grayscale Investments Zcash Trust into a U.S.-listed ETF — tracking Zcash — after the coin’s ~1,000% rally this year, marking a potentially first major retail-facing fund for a privacy coin. 

Nasdaq ISE requested US regulators to raise the option-contract cap for iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) from 250,000 to 1,000,000 contracts — and to drop limits on physically settled FLEX options — arguing strong liquidity and growing institutional demand justify the upgrade. 

Securitize obtained EU approval to roll out a tokenized-securities trading platform based on Avalanche — potentially expanding regulated tokenization and digital securities in Europe. 

The news around fresh legal action alleged against Binance includes claims of involvement in transactions linked to Hamas — sparking another wave of scrutiny over the exchange’s compliance and counter-terrorism enforcement.

Reports indicate that the token tied to Donald Trump (WLFI token) saw a 50% drop, highlighting volatility amid negative sentiment or sell-pressure linked to political or regulatory developments.

In Thailand, there’s widespread public demand for Sam Altman to erase more than 1.2 million biometric iris scans — reflecting rising concerns over privacy and data-collection practices tied to emerging tech use.

The founder of Polygon sparked debate with a poll proposal to potentially revert aspects of the network's protocol — stirring community discussion about trade-offs between decentralization, performance, and governance.

PayPal launched a campaign dubbed “CryptoSweeps,” signaling its move to more actively engage users in crypto-related promotions and possibly lower barriers to crypto participation among mainstream audiences.

asr.full_text: hello and welcome to crypto news today november 27 2025 and the top crypto news is as follows let's start with our spot bitcoin etfs which as of november 26 had a total inflow of 21 million dollars while ethereum etfs were at 60 million dollars in inflows as you can see the numbers are low however grayscale tells us that it has filed a request with the Securities and Exchange Commission SEC to convert a Zcash trust it has into a regular spot ETF, and we expect an ETF for Zcash now that its price has increased. Meanwhile Nasdaq has also filed a petition with the Securities and Exchange Commission SEC to increase the limit on BlackRock's Bitcoin ETF options from 250,000 contracts on each side to 1 million contracts this would bring blackrock's bitcoin etfs to the same level of liquidity as other major products in the world so theoretically if this happens we could see more volatility in blackrock's bitcoin etf meanwhile securitize has received approval from the european union for a tokenization platform specifically securitize has received a license from the European Union to operate a regulated exchange and settlement system, making it the only company with a licensed tokenization infrastructure in both the US and the European Union. So it will deploy the European Exchange and Regulation System on Avalanche. Saying that Avalanche is, Very fast as a network and well designed for institutional use. The first release, under the new license, is expected to be released in early 2026, entirely on Avalanche. Continuing, we will look at an exchange for today and we will refer to Binance, which has received a new complaint against it. Specifically, Binance and its founder, Mr. CZ, were served with a new lawsuit on Monday in which the complaint alleges that the exchange created a system over a six-year period that allowed the exchange of cryptocurrency is associated with Hamas. This complaint came from more than 300 American families who were killed or injured in Hamas attacks and say that Binance did not have sufficient control between 2017 and 2023 over the exchange. As a result, it couldn't properly serve customers. So it allowed people associated with Hamas to transfer money that went to Hamas. Moving on to our coins, we'll go to World Liberty Finance, the DeFi of the president of the United States. Which is expanding its coin buybacks as its price is less than 50% of the price it was released at. Let's say now that what they did, is they bought $7.7 million worth of World Liberty Finance coins at a price of 16 cents per coin. According to all of this with the Look Unchained platform. Let's say that this is a much larger buyback than the one they did on September 27th where they bought another $0.6 million worth of World Liberty Finance. Moving on, we'll go to World. The coin of Sam, the to world, the coin of sam, the guy who was the ceo of open ai, for which we learn that Thailand has requested the it delete data from 1.2 million eye scans taken by thai citizens, lets say that the coin has already ceased operations there, as authorities are reporting privacy violations to thai citizens, and apparently asked them to delete the data. We'll also go to Polygon where the co-founder of Polygon is considering renaming poll to Matic because no one knows. Let's say that as we said the co-founder stated that while he personally believes it should stay at poll, he continues to hear feedback from the community that the original Matic has stronger recognition, especially among retail users who are now confused. He gave his opinion on X. Or in simpler terms, he says that everyone knew Matic since they renamed it to Paul. Very few people know Paul, so that's bad for marketing. That's probably why they're thinking about changing it again. That's not for sure. Those are his thoughts. And we're here to go to our favorite cryptocurrency market, Bitcoins, at $91,000. 000 and today or tomorrow it's going to have its first test to see if we can break our first resistance to go higher and let me tell you we're slowly getting into the holiday spirit so we might see a little rally there and paypal's already preparing the ground as they're telling us to win big with bitcoin over the holidays and they've actually done a giveaway where they're gonna win over one thousand winners, And they're going to give away over 1 million dollars in rewards. Let's say the way to participate is to have made a trade or held Paypal stable coin in your Paypal wallet. And thus you have entered the draw where you can win up to 100,000 in BTC. Let me tell you that I will have everything in the description for you and the sources if you want to check out this particular giveaway. Besides we see that companies are preparing for the Christmas holidays, during which the market can usually have a small rally. Obviously nothing is certain." That wraps up the Top news for Crypto today, November 27th, 2025.
